timecoded_text_to_speech.text: So, you just wish you could save the position of certain bones and call them whenever you want.
In order to save a pose, select all the bones involved, under the run-and-man, go to pose libraries,
new, press the plus, add new, and name the pose whatever you want.
And when you're done, make sure that you check this button.
Otherwise, you will lose all of your data even if you save.
Why the flying f**k this isn't set to on by default is beyond me.
But make sure that button is checked or everything you did that day is gone.
You can add as many new poses as you want by repeating the process and select an add new.
Or if you want to change an old pose, select it, fix your bones, and click replace existence.
Once you've got all your poses, you can activate them by picking one and clicking on the magnifying glass.
If you enjoyed this video, please don't forget to like, subscribe, and ring that bell.
Hope you have a fantastic day, and I'll see you around.
